tips.title: Be specific about the subject
tips.body: Name the product, surface, and setting. Vague briefs produce generic stock looks.

tips.title: Lock style and light
tips.body: Pick one style and one lighting cue so the model does not invent a new look each run.

tips.title: Leave space for type
tips.body: If you add a headline or CTA, ask for clean negative space so text stays readable.

frontFaq.q: Why is this better than random prompts?
frontFaq.a: You get a repeatable Plan → Create → Check → Improve workflow with clear fields and evaluation — structured prompting, not prompt gambling.
20–30 minutes is enough if you run Create → Check → Improve.

frontFaq.q: What is the creative brief builder?
frontFaq.a: A free browser tool on this page: fill a short marketing brief and get an image-ready prompt to copy into ChatGPT or Ideogram. No account. It demonstrates the same tool-building idea Pro teaches for teams.

frontFaq.q: Is this a course or a tool?
frontFaq.a: A copy-paste Content AI System you can use immediately — not a long course. Free spine + brief in the browser; depth offline in the kits.

frontFaq.q: Why use this instead of more AI tools?
frontFaq.a: It is a portable prompt system you run on ChatGPT or Claude — not another SaaS seat. Structured workflows replace random chats and reduce tool sprawl.

frontFaq.q: How do you protect brand voice before publishing?
frontFaq.a: Set session context and non-negotiable rules, then run the pre-publish safety reviewer to check facts, tone, legal/trust risk, and CTA ownership before you ship.
CMOs, marketing leads, product/growth teams, and leaders who need a fast, repeatable content cadence.

frontFaq.q: How is this different from prompt templates?
frontFaq.a: You get a sequence, clear fields, evaluation, and a KPI loop — not a one-off output.

frontFaq.q: Does this work for B2B SaaS, services, and ecommerce?
frontFaq.a: Yes. Swap the audience, offer, channels, and metrics — the structure stays the same.

buyerFaq.q: How and when do I get my PDF?
buyerFaq.a: Pay through Stripe. Within 5 minutes you receive an email from info@promptanatomy.app with signed download link(s). Bundle buyers receive separate links for Starter and Pro. If email does not arrive, contact us and we will resend.

buyerFaq.q: What does the team license cover?
buyerFaq.a: One in-house marketing team at one company. CMO + 1–4 directs, or one CMO equivalent. Print and share within that team. No agency, multi-brand, or training-resale rights without a separate license.
Yes. 14-day no-questions refund. Reply to your Stripe receipt or email info@promptanatomy.app. We approve through Stripe and revoke the download link.

buyerFaq.q: How is this different from the free library?
buyerFaq.a: The free library lets you use the system in your browser, including the Creative brief builder for image-ready prompts. The kits add depth and team assets: offline and printable, with worked examples, full prompt bodies (Pro), scenario plays, a safety reviewer, a 90-minute workshop, and — in Pro — a method for building your own reusable workflows and tools. You buy the system depth and the team license, not just a PDF.

buyerFaq.q: Is the PDF a live app?
buyerFaq.a: No. PDF is the delivery format for the content operating system — offline, printable, workshop-ready. There is no login or hosted dashboard.

buyerFaq.q: Will my data be sold or shared?
buyerFaq.a: No. Stripe processes payment and Resend delivers the email — we store no marketing list and do not add you to one. Post-purchase tips are transactional only. See our privacy page.
